# Sequence lists from older TF2 installs, for translating an old demo's m_nSequence (B380, D160).
#
# A networked sequence number is an index into the model the RECORDING client loaded, merged with
# its included models (virtualmodel_t::AppendSequences, studio_virtualmodel.cpp:142). Valve later
# reordered some models, so an old demo's number means a different animation in today's files.
# Each model line below is that model's merged list as the old install had it, index by index, as
# label:activity. Only models whose list differs from today's appear.
#
# Generated by `sequence-eras <install> 0 emit` (tools/Tf2DemoSalvage.Probe), player models left
# out because m_nSequence is not in a player's send table. Regenerate if today's content changes.
#
#   protocol <demo network protocol> <era>   which era a demo's header selects
#   era <name>                                starts that era's model lines
#   <model path> TAB <label:activity> ...     one line per model, fields tab-separated

protocol 11 2007
protocol 14 2008
